payload.summary: All four amendments are verified against the source code and accepted. Amendment fr-1-206e00d0 identifies a real consistency gap between feeding_units() and add_reserve_by_feeding_units() where the ADULT_FEEDING_WEIGHT constant is omitted. The remaining three amendments identify interconnected regressions in the stage-structured shrimp lifecycle: presets/scenarios silently drop new stage tuning knobs, the v4→v5 migration fails to preserve legacy maturation timing, and load-time invariant validation has no coverage of ShrimpRuntimeParams fields.

votes.rationale: Verified: feeding_units() at biology.rs:451 multiplies adult count by ADULT_FEEDING_WEIGHT, but add_reserve_by_feeding_units() at biology.rs:491 uses bare f64::from(self.adult.count). The docstring at line 484 explicitly states this method uses 'the same weights that the legacy feeding model used for daily food demand', so omitting the constant violates the documented contract. Currently harmless because the constant is 1.0 (line 154), but this is a latent divergence bug.

Verified: ShrimpPreset (presets.rs:134-156) lacks all new stage-structured fields (juvenile_to_subadult_days, subadult_to_adult_days, base_molt_interval_days, sub_adult_sensitivity, base_clutch_size, min_clutch_condition). Scenario materialization (lib.rs:511-523) fills ShrimpRuntimeParams with ..ShrimpRuntimeParams::default(), so all these knobs silently get hard-coded defaults. Meanwhile process_params.shrimp_juvenile_maturation_days is loaded (lib.rs:422) but stage promotion reads only state.shrimp_params (shrimp.rs:610). This is a real configuration bug where preset/scenario data cannot control lifecycle behavior.

Verified: migrate_v4_to_v5 (save.rs:408-573) rewrites the animal state shape but never touches shrimp_params. The new ShrimpRuntimeParams fields juvenile_to_subadult_days and subadult_to_adult_days are not derived from legacy process_params.shrimp_juvenile_maturation_days. They deserialize to defaults of 30.0 and 20.0 (biology.rs:347-352). An older save with a non-default maturation schedule will therefore silently change lifecycle timing on load. The migration is structurally incomplete.

Verified: into_engine (save.rs:215-226) calls enforce_invariants, but validate_invariants_inner (invariants.rs:215-252) ends at process_params validation and never checks any ShrimpRuntimeParams fields. The runtime code defensively clamps values (e.g., .max(1.0) at shrimp.rs:610, .max(0.01) at shrimp.rs:940/966) instead of failing fast. This means malformed saves or API inputs with impossible stage timing, temperature ranges, or GH settings will load successfully and run with silently sanitized values rather than being rejected at the validation boundary.
